rules.source_quote: Suspected choledochal cyst after ultrasound has been done

criteria.description: Clinically suspected choledochal cyst or congenital biliary duct dilatation
Initial diagnostic workup with abdominal ultrasound completed

required_documentation: Abdominal ultrasound report documenting biliary tree visualization prior to MRCP
rules.review_notes: Prerequisite ultrasound requirement prior to MRCP for congenital biliary cyst.

rules.source_quote: Suspected new onset acute pancreatitis and ALL of the following: ○ Epigastric or upper abdominal pain

criteria.description: Documented epigastric or upper abdominal pain

required_documentation: Clinical notes detailing epigastric pain and reason for MRI/MRCP (e.g. occult choledocholithiasis, pregnancy, or iodinated contrast allergy)
rules.review_notes: Pancreatitis evaluation by MRI/MRCP for ductal stones.
